description.value: The One BBQ Kitchen is a Hong Kong-style Cantonese BBQ restaurant on Victoria Drive in Vancouver, founded with a mission to recreate authentic Hong Kong street food culture. The menu centres on house-made BBQ meats including the signature Devil's Char Siu and Peking Duck, served for both lunch and dinner. Customer reviews highlight attentive service and a warm neighbourhood atmosphere, and the restaurant offers both dine-in and online order pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for onebbq.ca loaded successfully and confirms the business name, address (6978 Victoria Dr), and phone (604-321-3333) matching OSM. The site clearly shows online ordering pickup and delivery options, confirming takeout. The website footer note indicates the cached version was served by the Wayback Machine Downloader, which may mean the content is archival rather than live.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active restaurant well-suited as a food stop for touring cyclists, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence.
